items.text: Ladd McConkey rib/chest injury day-to-day per Harbaugh; status up in the air for Week 2 vs Raiders, monitored all week.
items.implication: High risk sit or GTD; check midweek practice.
items.opportunity: If out, Tre Harris/Derius Davis upside in LAC offense.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring injury not serious, day-to-day; would have returned if playoff game; MRI pending but optimistic.
items.why: Sources to Rapoport; aggravated but mild.
items.implication: Monitor practice; likely play Week 2 or close.
items.opportunity: If out, Bateman/Lane (wrist out) beneficiaries reverse if in.

items.text: Malik Nabers is active for Week 1 after prior uncertainty/knee concerns; he played and looked healthy with solid target share.
items.why: Late decision confirmed active by Schefter and Rapoport; postgame healthy comments and 31% targets.
items.implication: Start in all formats; decoy risk low given usage.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share restored post-ACL recovery.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play Week 1 per weekend reports; status affects Saints RB projections.
items.why: ETR summary of reports; confirmed absence impacted usage.

items.text: Lions offense extremely concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 93% of opportunities (65/70); no RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: Post-game opportunity shares confirm expected concentration.
items.implication: Lock in the core four; avoid Lions depth.
items.opportunity: Elite snap/route/target monopoly for the four.

items.text: Bucky Irving healthy and efficient: only 8 carries/21 routes/7 targets but sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13; 22.3 PPR overstated by TD but strong signs; great vs CLE.
items.why: Goal-line work and route win despite modest volume.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with TD upside and matchup.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and passing-down role locked; healthy post any prior issues.

items.text: Kyler Murray in concussion protocol, status uncertain for Week 2; participating in meetings; Wentz strong fill-in option vs Bears if out.
items.why: O'Connell comments; medical decision late week.
items.implication: Monitor; Wentz viable streamer if Murray sits.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not fully dominate with Kamara out: snaps 53/26/15 vs Miller/Donaldson, routes 24/5/7, opportunities 18/9/4; committee persists.
items.why: Even without Kamara, split work limited dominate share.
items.implication: Etienne solid but not must-start RB1; Miller handcuff value.
items.opportunity: If Kamara returns or more absence, monitor split.

items.text: Brock Bowers day-to-day post meniscus cleanup, working hard to return; short-term only; Mayer filled in with 6 catches.
items.opportunity: Mayer streams if Bowers misses another.

items.text: A.J. Brown high ankle sprain, placed on IR, expected out about six weeks.
items.implication: Stash if IR spot; NE WRs elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other Patriots receivers.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play and was active Week 1; risk/reward RB2 start per analysts.
items.why: ETR weekend report; played through ankle sprain.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside; monitor snap share vs Allgeier.

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) expected to play and officially active Week 1.
items.why: ETR report corroborated by Schefter active confirmation.

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays; buy-low everywhere, want all shares.
items.why: Elite route share despite production; FF Happy Hour.
items.implication: Hold/buy low TE; volume will convert.
items.opportunity: 92% routes signal featured role in Bears offense.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well underway after strong Week 1 showing.
